Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Sable Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5T and 3T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial field gradient of 1,900 Gauss/cm.
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 150 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- head transmit/receive coil only.
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil.
- WB-SAR ≤ 1 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 20 min.
- Wait 60 minutes before the next imaging session.
